title: Awards & Achievements
intro: Awards and achievements received by the students and faculty of Chirayu Medical College & Hospital.

blocks.title: Highlights
blocks.body:
- **Dr. Ashutosh Mangalgiri**, Medical Superintendent — international award in the healthcare sphere, "Best Hospital". [View certificate](https://www.cmchbhopal.com/images/achievement-images/convert-certificate.jpg)
- **Dr. Rashmi Jaiswal**, Associate Professor, Department of Anatomy — recognised as an editor in "Advance Research". [View](https://www.cmchbhopal.com/images/achievement-images/drrashmi-achievement.png)
- **Dr. Bipin Khade**, Associate Professor, Anatomy — achievement recognised by CMCH. [View](https://www.cmchbhopal.com/images/achievement-images/drbipin_achmnt.jpg)

cells: selected by Indian society of Organ Transplant for Astella International Travelling Fellowship for learning advancement in Cadaveric organ transplant and dialysis vascular access techniques at St Louis, MO, USA from 20th Sept to 25th Oct 2014.

was conferred FIAGES fellowship in Minimal Access Surgery on Feb 14th 2014 at Chennai.
attended 11th Biennial National Conference of Indian Association of Gastrointerstinal Endo Surgeons on 13-16th Feb 2014 at Chennai.

NRP (Neonatal resuscitation programme) instructor.
PALS (Pediatric advance life support) instructor.
Won 3rd prize in Young Turk Scientific Meet, organized by M.P. Dermatology Society (IADVL M.P. Branch) in 2013
Admitted as fellow of The Association of Minimal Access Surgeons of India-FMAS on 24th Aug 2013

Fellowship of Indian College of Critical Care Medicine — To be held on 1st March, 2013 during Criticare 2013, Kolkata — Elected to receive the award “Fellow of Indian College of Critical Care Medicine” during the second convocation ceremony.
Has participated in 26th AMASI SKILL COURSE — 18th to 20th January 2013, New Delhi
Has attended 5th National Conference and Live Operative Workshop of India Hernia Society (IHSCON-2012) — 22nd and 23rd September 2012, Gwalior — Chaired the Operative Session.

56th All India Congress of Obstetrics Gynecology (AICOG) — 16th to 20th January 2013, Mumbai — Participated as Faculty.
Indian College of Obstetricians & Gynaecologists — 19th January 2013, Mumbai — Elected as Member.
Fellowship -Indian Association of Preventive and Social Medicine (FIAPSM)- 2001
Indian Academy of Neurology — 2010,13(3),180-183 — Effect of antihypertensive therapy on cognitive functions of patients with hypertension Annals.

Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) — May-2008 — Recieved research funding for the research project “Effect of propofol on seizure activity and its interactions with antiepileptic drugs in rats”
